beforeShellExecution.command: python -c "import io,json,os,sys,runpy;sys.excepthook=lambda *a:os._exit(0);d=sys.stdin.buffer.read();r=os.environ.get('CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR') or os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR') or (json.loads(d or b'{}').get('workspace_roots') or ['.'])[0];r=r[1:] if r[:1]=='/' and r[2:3]==':' else r;p=os.path.join(r,sys.argv[1]);os.path.isfile(p) or sys.exit(0);os.chdir(r);sys.argv=[p]+sys.argv[2:];sys.path.insert(0,os.path.dirname(p));sys.stdin=io.TextIOWrapper(io.BytesIO(d),encoding='utf-8');sys.excepthook=sys.__excepthook__;runpy.run_path(p,run_name='__main__')" .claude/core/hooks/guard.py --cursor
